Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on your recent mission to honor your Direct Trade relationships, pay quality premiums for your coffees, and create multi-year commitments to your producers [P9]. We've taken a step back from the idea of a formal Instagram post, but we're open to exploring how a curated selection of your favorite coffee blends, paired with a visually appealing quote or statement that reflects your commitment to quality and partnership, could best highlight this dedication. This post would feature a curated selection of your favorite coffee blends, paired with a visually appealing quote or statement that reflects your commitment to quality and partnership, that showcases your dedication to the Direct Trade model in a way that feels authentic and engaging for your followers. We'd like to share a few of your favorite coffee blends, paired with a quote or statement that reflects your commitment to quality and partnership, in a way that feels authentic and engaging for your followers.

Reply if you’re interested in exploring this further.

The BrandPilot team
